statements.t: We expect to complete enrollment in the 4WARD trial by the end of 2026.

Based on our cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities on hand as of November 4, 2026 and our current operating plan, we believe that our cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities will allow us to fund our operations and debt obligations for at least the next 12 months.
We expect to continue to incur operating losses as we advance our lead drug candidate through the 4WARD trial.
Until we reach profitability, we will need to raise additional capital, which cannot be assured, to fund our operations and meet our financial obligations beyond this period.
